stem.text: Which instrument action is most appropriate to improve exposure of the gallbladder neck during dissection?

options.text: Grasping the gallbladder neck and retracting it laterally and inferiorly

feedback.text: Proper neck retraction opens Calot's triangle and exposes the dissection plane.

options.text: Using a hook to push the gallbladder toward the liver

feedback.text: The hook is typically used for dissection, not for pushing the gallbladder.

options.text: Applying clips to the cystic duct to stabilize the field

feedback.text: Clips are used to ligate the duct or artery, not to stabilize or improve exposure of the field.
